text:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly — thank you everyone for the sprint on EU private beta. Topline: private GA readiness, SLA tightening, and short-term cost guardrails. We have three concrete asks and a metrics snapshot below. I want a tight playbook + comms by midweek so we can stick the GA date if the pilot looks clean.

Devon (VP Product): Thanks — playbook draft up, PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/playbooks/private-ga. I'll add the customer comms template today. @Sam can you confirm rollback steps?

Sam (VP Eng): Got it. SRE confirms rollback windows: typical model rollbacks ~15m; larger quantized/compat variants can take up to 45m. We'll add explicit health-check gates.

Priya (Head of Ops): I'm freezing new infra tickets for non-critical spend today. If you need exceptions, list them here by EOD.

Elena (Security): Heads up — data-retention policy for EU pilot: logs TTL 30 days, metrics retained 90 days. Compliance review scheduled Wed 14:00 CET.

ops-bot: Reminder: private-beta-checklist updated — 8 items remaining (see https://go/checklist).

Ava (CEO): Metrics snapshot (week-over-week): p75 latency 160ms (-8%), error rate 0.6% (target 0.25%; still elevated), cost per 1M tokens +4% (large-context usage). Priorities this week: 1) get error rate to <=0.35% 2) finish playbook & comms 3) lock canary + rollback policy.

Devon (VP Product): Customer comms draft in the PR comments. Suggest two variants: early adopters and general GA.

Sam (VP Eng): We'll gate the canary at 5% traffic for 48h, with automatic rollback if errors spike above 1% sustained over 5m. Adding the gate to rollout config now.

Priya (Head of Ops): Confirmed freeze on nonessential infra. Also posting a proposed budget cutoff list in #finance by lunchtime.

Ava (CEO): Two asks from me: 1) Product to publish comms draft by Wed EOD. 2) Eng/SRE to surface any rollout constraints today — otherwise we'll assume standard 5% canary. If error rate >1% during canary we hold GA and loop me in.

Sam (VP Eng): Acknowledged — surfacing a couple legacy model compatibility flags in the PR.

Devon (VP Product): Will do the comms by Wed and ping legal for the compliance blurb.

Ava (CEO): Thanks team. Quick sync Thurs 10:00 PT to finalize go/no-go. If anything changes before then, drop notes here or DM me. :thumbsup:
